novelty_search.nearest_result: L9H1/H4 retain 0.886/0.932 of the full is/was L9 route but fail P selectivity; has/had source decomposition found the literal cue weak and downstream period/determiner state dominant.
novelty_search.new_question: Within the fixed reused H1/H4 pair, is is/was temporal state likewise read from contextualized tokens downstream of the literal this/that cue?

population: All 32 A1/A2 is/was rows from matched-v2. Base and donor strings have equal token length and exactly one aligned this/that cue difference. P is excluded because its paraphrase insertion is not position-aligned; P nuisance remains explicitly unresolved.

operator.arm: For each named source, replace its paired donor attention pattern-times-effective-value term inside otherwise native base H1/H4 preprojection state; full_pair replaces complete paired donor H1/H4 preprojection vectors.
operator.exactness: A reused manual bilinear-attention implementation must match native selected logits and reconstruct H1/H4 source sums within 1e-4.
operator.no_rescue: No source, head, family, threshold, or row changes after execution.

bars.capability: Base and donor native accuracy >=0.85 in each A1/A2 x direction cell.
bars.full_pair: A1 and A2 mean recovery >=0.30 with direction fraction >=0.80.
bars.literal_cue_negative: Cue-only mean recovery is <=0.25 of full-pair mean recovery in A1 and A2.
bars.downstream_context: Moment plus determiner single-source mean recoveries sum to >=0.50 of full-pair mean recovery in each A family; at least one individually retains >=0.25 with direction fraction >=0.80.
bars.self_negative: Self-only absolute mean recovery <=0.25 of full-pair mean recovery in A1 and A2.
bars.price: 18 forwards/288 examples, five causal arms, zero fit/grid/root/backward/update.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: Hashes, aligned cue positions, native capability, manual logits, source reconstruction, finiteness, and 32 rows per arm pass.
predictions.pred_b_full_h1_h4_pair_recurrence: Full H1/H4 pair passes A1/A2 recovery and direction bars.
predictions.pred_c_literal_cue_is_not_sufficient: Cue-only retains <=0.25 of full recovery in both A families.
predictions.pred_d_downstream_moment_determiner_cont: Moment/determiner source terms meet the registered summed and individual contextual-read bars.
predictions.pred_e_self_negative_and_exact_price: Self remains <=0.25 of full recovery and exact zero-fit price passes.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: is/was shares the contextualized downstream-source reader architecture of has/had within L9H1/H4.
terminal.null: Instrument/full pair pass but literal-cue, downstream-context, or self prediction misses; retain only head-level reuse.
terminal.invalid: Authority, alignment, capability, exact instrument, full-pair liveness, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.
